hooks.command: DIR="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; p=$(jq -r '.prompt // empty'); printf '%s' "$p" | grep -qiw 'deepreview' && jq -n --rawfile ctx "$DIR/.claude/review-methodology.md" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"UserPromptSubmit",additionalContext:$ctx}}' 2>/dev/null || true

DIR="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; p=$(jq -r '.prompt // empty'); printf '%s' "$p" | grep -qiF 'done for the day' && jq -n --rawfile ctx "$DIR/.claude/save-methodology.md" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"UserPromptSubmit",additionalContext:$ctx}}' 2>/dev/null || true
DIR="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; [ -x "$DIR/scripts/memory-sync.py" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && timeout 25 python3 "$DIR/scripts/memory-sync.py" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
